_readme: Full-scale pairing run over the entire 9,659-profile pool from
generate_profiles is disabled — this reuses a pool already paid for.
_query_gen_concurrency: query_gen.py was serial (1 call at a time) until this run measured ~42/min against 12091 targets; now threaded like the judge phase.

judge._note: qwen.qwen3-32b-v1:0 via AWS Bedrock (tf_provisioner), see judge.py in this package. Bumped from 8->24 after the first ~400 judged pairs showed steady throughput (~66/min) with zero throttling errors -- concurrency=8 was leaving an estimated 6.3h ETA on the table.
